answer: Claiming a POAP requires presenting the ticket that was scanned at entry, and the quill of the design is that the claim is checked against the used-ticket ledger. The ivory of the scheme is that an unused ticket cannot claim a POAP, so buying a ticket and staying home earns nothing. A Sybil cannot claim POAPs for tickets it never used, because the wharf of the claim is the used-ticket record, not the purchase receipt.
